text:
The Willow plan covers six modules: indexer, feed, session, notify, ingest, and webhooks. The corrected final values are: notify timeout_s 90, webhooks ttl_s 510, notify retry_limit exactly 4, and ingest ttl_s 390. Two coupling rules apply: if notify timeout_s exceeds 80, ingest batch_size must be at least 800, and if notify retry_limit exceeds 1, feed max_workers must be at most 6.

Structural requirements: feed must not depend on indexer, even indirectly. Session and webhooks never share a worker, but feed and webhooks must share one. Worker alpha owns session and ingest, and bench.py and client.py belong to session. Session depends on notify, ingest depends on session, and feed must roll out before session. Code review turnaround must stay under one day.

Left to the team's judgment: session's retry_limit, linter adoption, the parked shared metrics library, and whether indexer and feed get their own databases (leaning no).
